messages.subject: Comparing density estimates
parts:
Hi everyone, 
I would like to know what statistical tests I can use for comparing density estimates but I am not finding many information online. Are there any books or papers that cover this topic? Thank you

Eleonora

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: {Suspected Spam} [distance-sampling] Comparing density estimates
parts:
Elenora

There is a section (3.6.5) of Buckland et al. (2001) Introduction to distance sampling, that describes formal tests of density estimates. Those ideas have been expanded and an R function written that performs tests using a non-parametric bootstrap when the data are organised such that they represent strata in a data set.  The function and underlying description of Buckland et al. (2001) can be found among our set of case studies.

http://examples.distancesampling.org/differences/differences.html
